description: Preview (may change before v0.10.0): List OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, Protobuf, JSON Schema, and SQL migration contracts in the working tree (action list), or compare them at two exact Git refs through Git objects without checking out either ref or changing the worktree (action diff). Each change is breaking, unknown, or compatible with before/after fingerprints; unparseable contracts are reported as diagnostics.

action.description: list (default) inventories the working tree; diff compares from..to

format.description: Output format: markdown (default) or json, case-insensitive

from.description: Earlier exact Git ref; required for diff

repo.description: Local checkout path (defaults to the MCP server repository)

to.description: Later exact Git ref; required for diff

name: fixmap_contracts
title: FixMap contracts
